Name: Harriet Beecher Stowe
Summary: American author and daughter of preacher Lyman Beecher whose 1852 novel, written from evangelical conviction that slavery was a sin, became the century's bestselling novel and a weapon of the abolition cause.
Contribution: Used the novel Uncle Tom's Cabin to turn American opinion against slavery, making Christian abolition a household cause.
KeyWorks: Uncle Tom's Cabin; A Key to Uncle Tom's Cabin
Testimony: She testified that she wrote the book as God gave it to her, believing slavery contradicted the Gospel she had been raised on.
